comum.registros: {n} record(s) · click a row to edit
comum.marque_confirmacao: Tick the confirmation box to delete.
comum.sem_vendas_grafico: No sales to show in the chart.

vendedores.aviso_comissao: Changing the default commission applies to new orders; existing orders keep their own percentage.
vendedores.excluir_confirmar: I confirm I want to delete this salesperson

regioes.novo_subtitulo: Closed region: each region has a single salesperson.
regioes.aviso_vendedor: Changing the salesperson applies to new orders; past orders stay with whoever made the sale.
regioes.sem_vendedores: Add a salesperson before creating regions.
regioes.excluir_confirmar: I confirm I want to delete this region

clientes.sem_regioes: Add a region before adding customers.
clientes.excluir_confirmar: I confirm I want to delete this customer

produtos.aviso_estoque: Stock goes down automatically when an item is sold (database trigger). Changing the price does not affect existing orders.
produtos.excluir_confirmar: I confirm I want to delete this product

novo.subtitulo: The salesperson comes from the customer's region
novo.sem_cadastros: Add at least one customer and one product to create orders.
novo.aviso_cliente: Choose the customer to fill in the salesperson and commission.
novo.itens_titulo: **Order items** — click ➕ below the table to add rows
novo.repetido: Product repeated in the order: {produtos}. Put it on a single row.

detalhe.todos_no_pedido: All products are already in this order.
detalhe.aviso_troca_cliente: If you change the customer, the salesperson becomes the one responsible for their region.
detalhe.excluir_confirmar: I confirm I want to delete this order
detalhe.excluir_aviso: Its items are deleted too and their stock is returned.

relatorios.aviso_regiao: Choose a region to see its customers.
relatorios.explicacao_comissao: Commission is calculated item by item with the percentage stored in each order. “Effective %” = commission ÷ total sold of the product.

erros.50002: The commission must be between 0 and 100.
erros.50013: The salesperson is not responsible for the customer's region.
erros.50014: The commission percentage must be between 0 and 100.
erros.50017: The quantity must be greater than zero.
erros.50018: The discount must be between 0 and 100.
erros.50019: The unit price cannot be negative.
erros.50020: This product is already in the order. Change the quantity of the existing item.
erros.50022: Not enough stock for product "{produto}" (ID {codigo}). Available: {disponivel}; required: {necessario}.
erros.50023: Cannot delete: the salesperson is responsible for {qtd} region(s). Move the regions to another salesperson first.
erros.50024: Cannot delete: the salesperson has {qtd} order(s).
erros.50025: Cannot delete: the region has {qtd} customer(s). Move the customers to another region first.
erros.50026: Cannot delete: the customer has {qtd} order(s).
erros.50027: Cannot delete: the product appears in {qtd} order item(s).
erros.50028: Another customer already has this tax ID (CPF/CNPJ).
erros.cpf_duplicado: A customer with this tax ID (CPF/CNPJ) already exists.
erros.driver_odbc: ODBC driver not found. Install "ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server" (see the README).
erros.procedure_ausente: {mensagem} — run sql/01_complemento.sql and sql/02_seed.sql on the database (see the README).
erros.banco_ausente: Database "{banco}" not found. Check DB_NAME in the .env file and whether sql/00_schema_reconstruido.sql was run.
erros.sem_conexao: Could not connect to SQL Server. Check that the server is running and the DB_MODE in .env (current: "{modo}").
erros.senha_docker: Set the sa user's password in DB_PASSWORD in the .env file.
erros.pedido_sem_itens: Add at least one item to the order.

nav.inicio: Sales summary: indicators, sales by region and latest orders.
nav.pedidos: Create orders, open an order and change its items, commission or date.
nav.relatorios: Six reports: by region, customer, salesperson and product, customers in a region and commission.
nav.vendedores: Salespeople and each one's default commission.
nav.regioes: Sales regions; each one is served by a single salesperson.
nav.clientes: Customers; each customer's salesperson comes from their region.
nav.produtos: Products, prices and stock (stock goes down automatically with each sale).

tooltips.idioma: Changes the interface language. The choice is kept in the page address (?lang=), so it survives F5.

kpi.total_vendido: Sum of all items sold, after discount: quantity × unit price × (1 − discount).
kpi.pedidos: Number of orders recorded in the database.
kpi.ticket_medio: Average value per order: total sold ÷ number of orders.
kpi.comissoes: Sum of commissions: each item × the commission percentage stored in its order.
kpi.vendedores: Registered salespeople. Each region is served by a single salesperson.
kpi.regioes: Registered regions (closed region: one salesperson per region).
kpi.clientes: Registered customers. Each customer's salesperson comes from their region.
kpi.produtos: Registered products: equipment, parts and services.

status.pedidos: Total orders recorded in the database.
status.vendidos: Total sold after discount, rounded. The exact value is on Home.
status.estoque_baixo: Products with fewer than {limite} units. Stock goes down automatically with each sale (database trigger).
status.estoque_ok: No product has fewer than {limite} units in stock.
status.banco: Database in use and connection mode, set in the .env file.

tooltips.novo: Clears the selected row and goes back to the add form.

pedido.comissao: Starts with the salesperson's default commission and can be changed for this order only. Changing the salesperson's commission later does not affect existing orders.
pedido.preco_unitario: Empty = the product's current price. The price is stored in the item: changing the product price later does not affect this order.
pedido.estoque_atual: Stock available now. When you save, the database lowers the stock automatically (trigger) and rejects the order if there is not enough.
pedido.total: Net order total: sum of the items after discount.
pedido.comissao_valor: Salesperson's commission on this order: each item × the order percentage.

produtos.estoque: Available quantity. Goes down automatically when an item is sold and comes back when the item or order is deleted (database trigger).

excluir.vendedor: Deletes the salesperson. Blocked if they are responsible for a region or have orders.
excluir.regiao: Deletes the region. Blocked if it has customers.
excluir.cliente: Deletes the customer. Blocked if they have orders.
excluir.produto: Deletes the product. Blocked if it already appears in an order.
excluir.pedido: Deletes the order and all its items; the items' stock goes back to the products.
excluir.item: Removes the item from the order; the quantity goes back to the product's stock.

relatorios.regiao: Total sold by region, using each customer's region. Also shows regions without sales.
relatorios.cliente: Total purchased by customer, from highest to lowest.
relatorios.vendedor: Total sold by salesperson (who made the order) and each one's total commission.
relatorios.clientes_regiao: Choose a region to see its customers and how much each one bought.
relatorios.produto: Quantity and total sold of each product, after discount.
relatorios.comissao: Commission statement for each salesperson broken down by product, using the percentage stored in each order.
relatorios.total_vendido: Sum of the items sold, after discount.
relatorios.comissao_valor: Sum of each item × the order's commission percentage.
relatorios.pct_efetivo: Commission ÷ total sold of the product. Varies when the same product was sold with different percentages.
